ClientResponses.Response: Hello, thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are very sorry to learn about the trouble you are experiencing with your Spirit II E-210. We do not paint the inside of our lids. What you are most likely seeing is carbonized grease. You can clean this off by preheating your grill with the lid closed using a heat-resistant bbq mitt. Grab a stainless steel brush, and brush it off. Once cooled, you can clean with warm soapy water. You can find more on this topic here: https://consumer-care.weber.com/hc/en-us/articles/360023605572-Why-is-the-inside-of-my-lid-peeling-. A 10-year warranty on all parts backs this unit! We are glad to see that our support team is assisting you with this. If you have any questions or corners, please do not hesitate to ask us. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

ClientResponses.Response: Hi! Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback on your new Spirit II E-210! We are very sorry to hear about the trouble you are experiencing with smoking on your new grill. We suggest using our Universal Smoker Box https://www.weber.com/US/en/accessories/accessories-by-category/smoking/smoker-box/7576.html. We recommend allowing your woodchips to soak in water for an hour before placing the woodchips in the Smoker Box. Then place the Smoker Box on top of the cooking grates and preheat your grill with the lid closed for 15 minutes. This will enhance the smokey flavor of your food! If you have other questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to reach out to our support team. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

Results.ReviewText: I wanted a smaller grill that would allow me to cook and smoke.  I've had this grill for only a short period 2-3 weeks, now (6/1/21). I've not been very successful at getting the smoking part to work...  I'll now need to get a separate smoker to accomplish smoking my meats.    Have tried using wood chips on the grill, on the fire, suspended under the grill..  nothing seems to work as I would expect.  I've been smoking meats for over 40 years, so don't think it's a lack of meat smoking knowledge, but maybe a lack of familiarity with this specific grill.  Since my intent was to both grill and smoke, I had to drop the rating
Results.Title: Can't smoke meats

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
